Triggers.value: A memory of the event coming to mind suddenly

Threat.value: I feel threatened by strangers approaching me even in ordinary situations
I find it harder to feel safe at night than during the day

Memory.value: Something in my surroundings can instantly bring back the full memory without warning
When I remember the event I feel intense rage
Sometimes I feel the full emotional intensity of the event without any clear image or memory

Negative Appraisals.value: My body keeps reacting as if I am still in danger even when I am safe
I will never forgive myself for not doing more to stop what happened

vignette: Rajiv, a 29-year-old South Asian man, has been struggling with the aftermath of physical abuse by his romantic partner. He runs a small shop in a bustling neighborhood, and the daily hustle should have brought him some sense of normalcy, but instead it amplifies his anxiety. The traumatic event itself was brutal and sudden. One evening, as Rajiv was closing up his shop, his partner showed up unexpectedly, fueled by rage and alcohol. The assault was swift, with blows that left Rajiv dazed and bruised. The smell of sweat and body odor mixed with the overwhelming fear and helplessness he felt during the attack. Since then, any whiff of sweat or strong body odors triggers a wave of panic and intrusive memories. Rajiv had come to believe that his body was his enemy, continually reacting as if danger lurked around every corner. He would often find himself hypervigilant, especially at night when the world seemed more menacing. The darkness intensified his sense of vulnerability, making it nearly impossible for him to feel safe until dawn broke. The assault had left Rajiv with a deep-seated guilt that he could not shake off. He was certain that if only he had reacted differently or done something more, perhaps he could have prevented the abuse. This constant self-blame exacerbated his feelings of helplessness and made it difficult for him to trust himself in similar situations. His shop, which used to be a source of pride and solace, now became a place where triggers lurked around every corner. Certain conversation topics with customers or vendors could unexpectedly bring back the full memory of the event, leaving Rajiv feeling overwhelmed and on edge. He found himself avoiding conversations about relationships or past experiences, isolating himself from social interactions that once felt natural. The intrusion of memories also affected his ability to concentrate. At times, intense rage would surge through him when he recalled the abuse, making it challenging to focus on tasks at hand. Other moments were marked by an overwhelming emotional intensity without a clear memory, leaving Rajiv feeling raw and exposed. Rajiv's sleep problems began shortly after the assault. He found himself constantly waking up in the middle of the night, bathed in sweat and drenched with fear. The lack of rest only compounded his irritability and difficulty managing daily stressors. His relationship suffered as a result; he and his partner now communicated less frequently and avoided discussing personal matters altogether. The cumulative effect of these symptoms was profound. Rajiv's business began to suffer due to his frequent absences and reduced engagement with customers. He felt like a shadow of the man he once was, someone who could no longer rely on himself in critical moments. His partner noticed the changes but often attributed them to work stress, leaving Rajiv feeling misunderstood and isolated. What finally brought Rajiv to seek help was an incident at his shop where a customer, approaching him with the usual friendly chatter, triggered a wave of panic and rage. He reacted sharply, causing a scene that left both him and the customer shaken. This episode highlighted for Rajiv how deeply his trauma affected not just himself but those around him. Rajiv is now most afraid that he will continue to spiral downward, unable to break free from the cycle of fear and guilt. Yet, he also holds onto hope that with help, he can regain a sense of control over his life and find peace in both his personal and professional worlds.
